vehicle: 2005 Honda Civic EX Coupe, US, Rallye Red, 5MT

frames.label: Five-speed EX driver profile · Nexus Auto Brokers
frames.limit: Stock-body US-market five-speed EX photographed in Magnesium Metallic. The listing identifies replacement 195/65 tires.
frames.observation: The side view shows the stock EX wheels, door length, rear quarter glass and trunk. At 18 positions along the roof, the registered silhouette averages 3.3 px from the photographed edge at 960 px image width.
frames.credit: Photograph by Nexus Auto Brokers, via Bring a Trailer. The tracing follows visible edges in the photograph.

frames.label: EX grille and headlamps · American Honda
frames.limit: US-market EX with the five-spoke wheels and stock front bumper. Its metallic paint differs from the Rallye Red model.
frames.observation: At six columns across the upper grille, its median height is 35 px in Honda’s photograph and 34 px in the model, measured at 960 px image width. The previous model measured 51 px in the earlier camera fit.
frames.credit: Photograph by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The tracing follows visible edges in the photograph.

frames.label: Red facelift coupe • IFCAR
frames.limit: US facelift coupe photographed in 2006. Its black mirrors, wheels and roof differ. Only shared bodywork and red appearance are compared.
frames.observation: The red coupe shows the near wheel arch and the shoulder line through the door handle. The wheel covers and black mirror housing differ.
frames.credit: Photograph by IFCAR. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: 2005 LX rear • MercurySable99
frames.limit: Second photograph of the same 2005 LX. Wheel covers, body trim and omission of an EX moonroof differ.
frames.observation: The stock rear three-quarter shows the triangular lamp, lower bumper and fixed rear glass. LX trim changes the wheels and roof equipment.
frames.credit: Photograph by MercurySable99. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: Reverb rear lamp detail · Elise240SX
frames.limit: The Canadian Reverb adds a wing and lower bumper extensions. The driver’s window is open and the brake and signal lamps are illuminated.
frames.observation: The outer red triangle, round clear inboard lens and sloping seam of the trunk opening are visible from the left rear.
frames.credit: Photograph by Elise240SX. Preview resized and converted to WebP.

frames.label: EX passenger profile
frames.observation: The two hub centers set the scale for comparing the long front door, short trunk and raked roof. The model carries the five-spoke EX alloys.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Studio front three-quarter
frames.limit: Canadian appearance package has a chin extension, skirt, spoiler and alternate wheels.
frames.observation: The near headlamp turns from the honeycomb grille into the fender. On the Canadian car the accessory front skirt extends below the stock bumper.
frames.credit: Reference photography by Honda Canada. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Studio driver profile
frames.limit: Compare roof and wheelbase. The Canadian aero package changes the lowest silhouette.
frames.observation: The axle centers, side glass and roof are visible throughout this broadside view. The accessory rear wing, wheels and side skirts differ.
frames.credit: Reference photography by Honda Canada. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Rear quarter and fuel door
frames.limit: Canadian aero-kit car. Rear lamps and quarter glass are shared.
frames.observation: The triangular lens wraps onto the quarter just behind the fuel lid. The Canadian rear wing crosses the top of the trunk.
frames.credit: Reference photography by Honda Canada. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Facelift grille and bumper
frames.limit: Canadian car in blue with a different wheel option.
frames.observation: The lens tips and the ends of the grille define the frontal shape. The photographed blue body catches the sky across the bumper.
frames.credit: Reference photography by Honda Canada. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Driver-side front wing
frames.limit: Canadian car in blue with a different wheel option.
frames.observation: This view exposes the arc of the front arch and the line from the fender to the door pull. The wheels differ.
frames.credit: Reference photography by Honda Canada. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Rallye Red front
frames.observation: The body-colour dividers separate the center intake from the smaller side openings. The red EX also shows the raised outer hood ridges.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Stock trunk and rear lamps
frames.limit: LX wheels and trim differ. The stock trunk pressing, fixed rear glass and bumper are shared.
frames.observation: Compare the sloping rear glass, recessed plate pocket, triangular lamps and the lower edge of the stock trunk. The LX wheels differ.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: EX bumper and stance
frames.observation: Honda’s blue EX shows the stock bumper, lamp-to-fender transition and five-spoke front wheel.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Rallye Red elevated view
frames.limit: Other cars in the printed layout are excluded from comparison.
frames.observation: The elevated view of the red EX exposes the shape of the hood, windshield and moonroof. The other three cars belong to the brochure layout.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Studio rear wheel and greenhouse
frames.limit: Special Edition wheels and wing differ.
frames.observation: The long door and quarter glass are visible nearly in profile. The Special Edition car carries different wheels and a rear wing.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Rear lamps and trunk width
frames.limit: Accessory car is cropped at the roof and has a spoiler.
frames.observation: The cropped accessory-car image shows the rear deck and bumper. Its wing and low source resolution limit comparisons of small details.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: 2005 LX front • MercurySable99
frames.limit: Stock 2005 LX. Wheels, mirror finish and roof equipment differ from the modeled EX.
frames.observation: The right front corner shows the arc of the lens, the hood edge and the bumper return against the front wheel.
frames.credit: Photograph by MercurySable99. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: Facelifted front • IFCAR
frames.limit: 2004–05 LX photographed in Maryland. Front plate bracket, wheel covers and trim differ.
frames.observation: The front plate bracket partially covers the center intake. The near lamp and bumper corner remain visible.
frames.credit: Photograph by IFCAR. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: 2004 LX front • Cutlass
frames.limit: The 2004 facelift shares the 2005 panels. This LX has steel-wheel covers, black mirrors and a solid roof.
frames.observation: The front-right view exposes the amber reflector and the outer curvature of the headlamp. The model approximates the reflector fluting.
frames.credit: Photograph by Cutlass. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: 2004 LX rear • Cutlass
frames.limit: The matching 2004 LX rear view establishes bumper and lamp returns. Wheels, paint and roof differ.
frames.observation: The rear-right view shows the lens corner, trunk pressing and rise in the lower bumper. The top of the roof is cropped.
frames.credit: Photograph by Cutlass. Public preview resized and converted to WebP. The opacity slider shows the reconstruction above the image.

frames.label: Facelift coupe, front left · RL GNZLZ
frames.limit: The photographed LX has a different grille emblem and fog lamps. The front tire contact patches are partly hidden by the curb.
frames.observation: Compare the shoulder crease passing through the handle, the glass opening and the lamp position relative to the near wheel.
frames.credit: Photograph by RL GNZLZ. Preview resized and converted to WebP.

frames.label: Facelift coupe, rear left · RL GNZLZ
frames.limit: The gray LX has a different mirror and upholstery configuration. Neighboring cars overlap parts of the outer silhouette.
frames.observation: Compare the raised trunk edge, triangular lens taper, fuel door, rear wheel arch and long door cutline.
frames.credit: Photograph by RL GNZLZ. Preview resized and converted to WebP.

frames.label: Canadian coupe side glass · Mack Male
frames.limit: The Canadian coupe carries skirts, a wing, tinted glass and a different wheel package.
frames.observation: The side view exposes the thin B-pillar, the length of the fixed quarter glass and the rake of the backlight.
frames.credit: Photograph by Mack Male. Preview resized and converted to WebP.

frames.label: Five-speed EX cockpit
frames.limit: The brochure shows the black EX cabin without the driver’s window glass in the sightline. Instrument graphics, silver bezel contours and seat upholstery remain simplified.
frames.observation: The black EX interior establishes the three-dial cluster, left-hand steering wheel, tall outer vents, two centre vents and manual shifter. The driver’s window is lowered for this camera.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: D17 VTEC ignition-cover detail
frames.limit: Honda shows a tight crop of the VTEC cover in studio lighting. Only this exterior cover, fasteners and visible ends of ignition packs can be compared. The image provides no check on the cylinder block, transaxle or internal parts.
frames.observation: The ignition-cover macro registers the raised HONDA and VTEC marks between two slotted fasteners and shows the front notches above the coil connections. The matched 3D camera isolates this cover and the visible coil hardware.
frames.credit: Reference photography by American Honda Motor Co., Inc. The feature tracing follows visible edges in the original photograph.

frames.label: Five-speed EX engine bay · Nexus Auto Brokers
frames.credit: Engine-bay photograph by Nexus Auto Brokers, via Bring a Trailer. The tracing follows visible edges in the photograph.
frames.limit: This 2005 US EX has the 1.7-litre VTEC engine and five-speed transaxle. It was photographed with its hood raised. Hardware hidden beneath the engine, hose routing and component depths remain approximate.
frames.observation: The open hood reveals the four coil packs, intake plenum, battery, front manifold heat shield and the tops of both struts. The overlaid tracing shows their installed position in the photographed car.

fitLandmarks: Pixel coordinates use the top left of each native source image. Residuals are 2D reprojection distances at native resolution. L/R in landmark IDs denote driver/passenger sides.
sourceGaps: A 2005 Honda EX configurator turntable and a freely downloadable factory body mesh were unavailable. No official installed five-speed gearset teardown photographs were found.
